svg.aria-label: SendGrid email deliverability hardening with SPF TXT record authorizing sender IPs, DKIM selector key signing payload integrity, DMARC policy ramp from none to quarantine to reject, aggregate RUA reports closing phishing and spoofing attack surface while restoring inbox placement rate.
svg.title: 2025-06-05: SendGrid SPF/DKIM/DMARC email auth stack, deliverability hardening

g.text: No SPF TXT record : DKIM missing : DMARC absent...
Brand impersonation : inbox collapses : ESP blocks...
MX lookup passes but SPF neutral : no DKIM signature :...
SPF TXT authorizes sendgrid.net IPs : DKIM...
DKIM selector1._domainkey CNAME : RSA-2048 key pair :...
DMARC none for baseline : quarantine after...
Aggregate RUA reports reveal unauthorized senders :...
Deliverability + anti-phish both restored : inbox rate...
